import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

field = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
salary = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Clean lookup
lookup['Cost Centre Code_norm'] = lookup['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
lookup['Programme_norm'] = lookup['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip()
lookup['State_norm'] = lookup['State'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Filter for Maternal and Child Health in Odisha
mch_odisha = lookup[
    (lookup['Programme_norm'] == 'Maternal and Child Health') &
    (lookup['State_norm'] == 'Odisha')
].copy()

print("MCH Odisha cost centres from lookup:")
print(mch_odisha[['Cost Centre Code','Cost Centre Code_norm']])

# Set of normalized codes
valid_codes = set(mch_odisha['Cost Centre Code_norm'].unique())
print("Valid codes:", valid_codes)

# Process field expenses
field['Transaction ID'] = field['Transaction ID'].astype(str)
field['Cost Centre_norm'] = field['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field['Posting Status_norm'] = field['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
field['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(field['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')

field_filtered = field[
    field['Transaction ID'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (field['Posting Status_norm'] == 'posted') &
    field['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(valid_codes)
].copy()

field_sum = field_filtered['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("\nField filtered count:", len(field_filtered))
print("Field sum:", field_sum)

# Process salary
salary['Payroll Line ID'] = salary['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str)
salary['Cost Centre_norm'] = salary['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary['Payroll Status_norm'] = salary['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
salary['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(salary['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')

salary_filtered = salary[
    salary['Payroll Line ID'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    (salary['Payroll Status_norm'] == 'paid') &
    salary['Cost Centre_norm'].isin(valid_codes)
].copy()

salary_sum = salary_filtered['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()
print("\nSalary filtered count:", len(salary_filtered))
print("Salary sum:", salary_sum)

combined = field_sum + salary_sum
print("\nCombined:", combined)

lookup['Programme_norm'] = lookup['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip()

valid_codes = set(
    lookup.loc[
        (lookup['Programme_norm']=='Maternal and Child Health') &

salary['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(salary['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')

field_filtered = field[
    field['Transaction ID'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (field['Posting Status_norm']=='posted') &

]

    salary['Payroll Line ID'].str.startswith('PAY-') &

]
